title: Prison Lab
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Aito Eyama, a high schooler bullied daily, is invited to a secret 'prison game' in which a player may confine anyone for a month and do anything short of killing them, winning money if their identity stays hidden. He imprisons Aya Kirishima, the ringleader of his bullies, and carries out a sadistic revenge while meeting other captors with hidden agendas (Coolmic text via AniList; MangaUpdates).
life_message: Revenge for bullying is explored as an intoxicating and corrupting power; the summaries do not show the story endorsing a good life.

content.note: Torture and captivity central (AniList Torture 76, Gore 70; MU Torture, Blood and Gore, Murder); publisher text: confinement with anything allowed but killing.
